Vitamin D levels: 22 ng/mL (deficient; normal range 30-50 ng/mL). Doctor prescribed 2,000 IU daily supplement. Scheduled retest in 3-4 months to monitor improvement. Note: Despite regular sun exposure, levels remain low, suggesting possible dietary or absorption factors.

Bone density scan results: Spine T-score -1.8 (osteopenia), Hip T-score -1.5 (borderline). Doctor advised strength training and increased calcium intake to prevent further bone loss. Patient now includes more dairy and leafy greens in diet and takes a calcium supplement with vitamin K2 to improve absorption.

Liver and kidney function: ALT 42 U/L (elevated; normal <35 U/L), possibly linked to recent medication changes. Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (normal range 0.6–1.2 mg/dL)—kidney function is within normal limits. Doctor recommends monitoring ALT closely and reviewing medication regimen.

Inflammatory markers: CRP 3.2 mg/L (slightly elevated; ideal <3.0 mg/L), likely related to osteoarthritis. ESR 18 mm/hr (within normal range: 0-20 mm/hr), indicating no major systemic inflammation.
